{"id":1508039444,"question_id":2766,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"1 year, 6 months","timestamp":1736836388,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"19 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1508039444/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find the Prefix Common Array of Two Arrays","memory":"88.5 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    vector<int> findThePrefixCommonArray(vector<int>& A, vector<int>& B) {\n        unordered_map<int ,int > freq;\n        vector<int>ans;\n        int count = 0;\n        for(int i =0 ; i<A.size(); i++)\n        {\n            freq[A[i]]++;\n            freq[B[i]]++;\n            if(freq[A[i]] == 2 ) \n            count++;\n            if(freq[B[i]] == 2 ) \n            count++;\n            if(A[i] == B[i])\n            count--;\n            ans.push_back(count);\n        }\n    return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-the-prefix-common-array-of-two-arrays","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":160}
